name: Naka (Tokushima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Naka town emblem in red, blue and green: a red oval and a blue curved stroke above a green arc.
history: Municipal flag of Naka, a town in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 2005.

features.role: Naka town emblem — a red oval and a blue curved stroke above a green arc
